description: This file contains shell script functions related to testing and working with Git multi-pack index files, including functions for verifying index consistency, calculating checksums, comparing Git modes, and orchestrating test assertions.

methods.name: test_midx_consistent
methods.description: Verifies the consistency of the multi-pack index in a given directory by checking the index files, reading the index, comparing expected and actual index contents, and verifying with Git commands.

methods.name: midx_checksum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum of the multi-pack index specified.

methods.name: midx_git_two_modes
methods.description: Compares the behavior of Git commands with multi-pack index enabled and disabled, optionally sorting the outputs for comparison.

methods.name: compare_results_with_midx
methods.description: Runs a series of Git operations under different modes and verifies their consistency, encapsulated as a test.
